title: The Perfect Will Again
author: Noor Thornbury
blurb: Rafael Halloran, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
